mapper.update: UPDATE public.tb_electronic_approval_line_info SET action_status = 'WAITING', pending_at = NULL, action_at = NULL, action_comment = NULL WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND electronic_approval_id = #{electronicApprovalId} AND participant_type IN ('APPROVAL', 'AGREEMENT')
mapper.select: SELECT electronic_approval_line_id, stage_order, participant_order, participant_type, participant_user_id, participant_name, participant_department_name, action_status, pending_at, action_at, action_comment FROM public.tb_electronic_approval_line_info WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND electronic_approval_id = #{electronicApprovalId} AND participant_user_id = #{participantUserId} AND stage_order > 1 AND participant_type IN ('APPROVAL', 'AGREEMENT') AND action_status = 'APPROVED' AND action_at IS NOT NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE public.tb_electronic_approval_line_info SET action_status = 'WAITING', pending_at = NULL, action_at = NULL, action_comment = NULL WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND electronic_approval_id = #{electronicApprovalId} AND stage_order > #{stageOrder} AND participant_type IN ('APPROVAL', 'AGREEMENT') AND action_status = 'PENDING' AND action_at IS NULL AND action_comment IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.tb_electronic_approval_line_info WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND electronic_approval_id = #{electronicApprovalId} AND stage_order > 1 AND participant_type IN ('APPROVAL', 'AGREEMENT') AND action_status IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'RETURNED')
mapper.update: UPDATE public.tb_electronic_approval_main SET drafting_work_category_id = #{draftingWorkCategoryId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, document_type = #{documentType}, eabus_no = #{eabusNo}, title = #{title}, contents_json = CAST(#{contentsJson} AS jsonb), contents_html = #{contentsHtml}, contents_text = #{contentsText}, drafter_name = #{drafterName}, drafter_department_name = #{drafterDepartmentName}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{drafterId} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND electronic_approval_id = #{electronicApprovalId} AND drafter_id = #{drafterId} AND document_status IN ('DRAFT', 'REVISION_REQUESTED') AND deleted_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.tb_electronic_approval_line_info ( tenant_id, electronic_approval_id, stage_order, participant_order, participant_type, participant_user_id, participant_name, participant_department_name, action_status, pending_at, action_at, action_comment, created_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{electronicApprovalId}, #{stageOrder}, #{participantOrder}, #{participantType}, #{participantUserId}, #{participantName}, #{participantDepartmentName}, #{actionStatus}, #{pendingAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{actionAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{actionComment}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.tb_electronic_approval_line_info l WHERE l.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND l.electronic_approval_id = m.electronic_approval_id AND l.participant_user_id = #{participantUserId} AND l.action_status = 'PENDING' ) THEN m.electronic_approval_id END) AS action_required_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.document_status IN ('PENDING', 'IN_PROGRESS') THEN m.electronic_approval_id END) AS in_progress_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.drafter_id = #{drafterId} AND m.document_status = 'DRAFT' THEN m.electronic_approval_id END) AS draft_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.document_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN m.electronic_approval_id END) AS completed_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.document_status = 'REVISION_REQUESTED' THEN m.electronic_approval_id END) AS revision_requested_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.document_status = 'REJECTED' THEN m.electronic_approval_id END) AS rejected_count FROM public.tb_electronic_approval_main m WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.deleted_yn = 'N' AND ( m.drafter_id = #{drafterId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.tb_electronic_approval_line_info l WHERE l.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND l.electronic_approval_id = m.electronic_approval_id AND l.participant_user_id = #{participantUserId} ) )

SELECT m.electronic_approval_id, m.eabus_no, m.document_type, m.document_status, m.title, m.drafter_name, m.created_at, m.updated_at, m.submitted_at, LEFT(COALESCE(m.contents_text, ''), 240) AS summary, CASE WHEN m.document_status = 'REVISION_REQUESTED' THEN 'REVISION_REQUESTED' ELSE 'ACTION_REQUIRED' END AS notice_type FROM public.tb_electronic_approval_main m WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.deleted_yn = 'N' AND ( ( m.drafter_id = #{drafterId} AND m.document_status = 'REVISION_REQUESTED' ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.tb_electronic_approval_line_info l WHERE l.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND l.electronic_approval_id = m.electronic_approval_id AND l.participant_user_id = #{participantUserId} AND l.action_status = 'PENDING' ) ) ORDER BY m.updated_at DESC, m.electronic_approval_id DESC LIMIT 3

INSERT INTO public.tb_electronic_approval_view_history ( tenant_id, electronic_approval_id, login_id, viewed_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{electronicApprovalId}, #{loginId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, electronic_approval_id, login_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING view_history_id

SELECT line.electronic_approval_line_id, line.stage_order, line.participant_order, line.participant_type, line.participant_user_id, line.participant_name, line.participant_department_name, la.profile_image AS participant_profile_image, CASE WHEN line.participant_type = 'APPROVAL' AND line.action_status IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'RETURNED') THEN la.stamp_image ELSE NULL END AS participant_stamp_image, line.action_status, line.pending_at, line.action_at, line.action_comment FROM public.tb_electronic_approval_line_info line LEFT JOIN public.tb_user u ON u.tenant_id = line.tenant_id AND CAST(u.user_id AS varchar) = line.participant_user_id LEFT JOIN public.tb_login_account la ON la.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND la.login_id = u.login_id WHERE line.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND line.electronic_approval_id = #{electronicApprovalId} ORDER BY line.stage_order, line.participant_order
